prompt: An enterprise wants internal actions shared company-wide but invisible to the public. What is the supported path?
explanation: Actions live in repositories, and an enterprise can share the ones in its internal repositories with all its organizations — no Marketplace, no public exposure. Workflows then reference them by `owner/repo/path@ref` like any other action.

options.text: Publish to the Marketplace with hidden visibility
Keep the actions in internal repositories and allow them via enterprise sharing
Ship them as encrypted archives downloaded by each workflow
Fork them into every repository that needs them
